project_name: QTS York County Data Center Campus
status_detail: York County says its only data center is being constructed by Quality Technology Services/QTS. QTS bought county and private land in July 2023, received FILOT approval on September 18, 2023, and county council approved a 2025 height text amendment and road-improvement agreement; state/county announcements describe the site near Hands Mill Highway and Campbell Road in unincorporated York County.
notes: County page states QTS has committed more than $8B in long-term investment and 200 permanent jobs; 2023 state announcement described an initial $1B investment and a $200,000 set-aside grant to York County for site preparation. Capacity not disclosed in official sources reviewed.

project_name: Sequitor Edge Brookings SDSU Research Park Data Center
aliases: Sequitor Edge Brookings Research Park co-location data center
status_detail: Local reporting from the February 24, 2026 Brookings City Council meeting says Sequitor Edge proposed a small-scale Tier III edge/co-location data center at 2324 Research Park Way in the SDSU Research Park; council denied a city sales-tax rebate 7-0 but described the vote as not a rejection of the overall project, and the company said the project would move forward pending land/lease matters.
notes: Reported private investment is more than $41M. Initial load would be 2 MW with gradual buildout up to 10 MW; one-time closed-loop cooling fill of about 19,000-20,000 gallons; goal operational by Q2 2027. City manager said city has limited planning/zoning jurisdiction because the contemplated site is state-owned Research Park land.
